probe.title: {{section}} · Connection test
probe.scopeHint: Runs against the values in this form (including unsaved edits). Nothing is saved.

client.title: Client settings
client.unavailable: This page is only available inside the Android app
client.bridgeMissing: The app is not responding to page requests. Reinstall or update it
client.chromiumOutdated: Chromium {{major}} is below the {{min}} this frontend needs. Update the system WebView, otherwise the layout and styles will be incomplete

download_resources.label: Download on scrape
download_resources.description: Cover/poster/stills are still downloaded when opening a movie's detail page, even if not selected here

crop_poster.label: Crop Poster
crop_poster.description: Auto-crop poster from the cover image

poster_crop_skip_ratio.label: Poster crop skip threshold
poster_crop_skip_ratio.description: Skip cropping when the existing poster's height exceeds this fraction of the cover height

poster_ratio.label: Poster Crop Ratio
poster_ratio.description: Width-to-height ratio for cropping the poster from the cover

jpeg_quality.label: JPEG Quality
jpeg_quality.description: Image save quality (1-100), higher means larger file size

field_priority.label: Field Priority
field_priority.description: Set priority for specific fields. Other sites in the type route are still requested

field_blacklist.label: Field Exclusions
field_blacklist.description: Sites a field must not use

base_url.label: Custom Domain
base_url.description: Override the default domain for this site

use_proxy.label: Use Proxy
use_proxy.description: Route requests through the configured proxy

proxy.label: Site Proxy
proxy.description: Dedicated proxy for this site; empty uses the global proxy. Turns direct when "Use Proxy" is off

browser_backend.label: Browser Backend
browser_backend.description: Overrides the global backend; "off" disables the browser for this source

cookie.label: Cookie
cookie.description: For sites that require sign-in, etc

rate_limit.label: Rate Limit
rate_limit.description: Max requests per second for this site

languages.label: Language Priority
languages.description: First entry with body text wins

content_routes.label: Type Routes
content_routes.description: Sources and default priority by content type

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry limit on request failure, excluding the first attempt; 0 sends a single request

solver_url.label: Solver URL
solver_url.description: FlareSolverr-compatible service URL; used by the solver backend only

chunked_threshold.label: Chunked Threshold
chunked_threshold.description: Use chunked download above this size (bytes)

rate_limits.label: Rate Limits
rate_limits.description: Limit request rate by host (e.g. javdb.com). Takes priority over per-site settings

default_rate_limit.label: Default Rate Limit
default_rate_limit.description: Default request rate for sites without an override

response_cache_ttl_s.label: Response Cache TTL
response_cache_ttl_s.description: How long search and detail responses are reused across tasks, in seconds; 0 disables

response_cache_max_entries.label: Response Cache Entries
response_cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of cached responses; 0 disables

adaptive_rate_limit.label: Adaptive Rate Limit
adaptive_rate_limit.description: Adjust the request rate between the configured rate and the floor by site response; disable to use a fixed rate

adaptive_rate_floor_ratio.label: Adaptive Rate Floor Ratio
adaptive_rate_floor_ratio.description: Floor = site configured rate × this ratio

proxies.label: Proxy Pool
proxies.description: Ordered proxy list picked in turn; empty disables the pool. Site-level proxies still take precedence

proxy_circuit_fail_max.label: Proxy Circuit Threshold
proxy_circuit_fail_max.description: Consecutive proxy-side failures before the proxy is taken out of use; site timeouts do not count

proxy_circuit_cooldown_s.label: Proxy Circuit Cooldown
proxy_circuit_cooldown_s.description: Seconds the proxy stays suspended; one probe is then let through, and success restores it

host_circuit_fail_max.label: Site Circuit Threshold
host_circuit_fail_max.description: Consecutive failures before a site is paused; kept higher than the proxy threshold so one flaky site cannot drag others down

host_circuit_cooldown_s.label: Site Circuit Cooldown
host_circuit_cooldown_s.description: Seconds a paused site waits before one probe is let through

image_rate_limits.label: Image Rate Limits
image_rate_limits.description: Per-host rate limit for image downloads, independent of page requests, so fetching images is not throttled by the site's page rate

image_default_rate_limit.label: Default Image Rate Limit
image_default_rate_limit.description: Image download rate for hosts without an explicit entry

enabled.label: Task Engine
enabled.description: When off, no task is claimed for execution; enqueueing and running tasks are unaffected, and this state persists across restarts

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of tasks to run at once

shutdown_timeout.label: Shutdown Timeout
shutdown_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for active tasks on shutdown (seconds)

retry_max_attempts.label: Retry Attempts
retry_max_attempts.description: Automatic retry limit for environmental failures (circuit open / timeout / 5xx / all sources skipped); 0 disables retries

retry_base_delay_s.label: Retry Base Delay
retry_base_delay_s.description: Seconds to wait before the first retry; should exceed the proxy circuit cooldown

retry_max_delay_s.label: Retry Max Delay
retry_max_delay_s.description: Upper bound of the exponential backoff interval (seconds)

use_polling.label: Polling Mode
use_polling.description: Use polling instead of system events (for network filesystems)

debounce_seconds.label: Debounce Window
debounce_seconds.description: Wait time after a file change before processing (seconds)

media_extensions.label: Media Extensions
media_extensions.description: Media file extensions to watch and scan, comma-separated

executable.label: es.exe Path
executable.description: Leave empty to auto-detect the usual install locations; Windows only

instance.label: Everything Instance
instance.description: Leave empty to use the default instance

poll_interval.label: Enumeration Interval
poll_interval.description: How often to re-enumerate an Everything library from its index (seconds)

timeout_ms.label: Index Load Timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the Everything index to become ready (ms); a timeout skips this round

enabled.label: Upscale on scrape
enabled.description: If off, you can still upscale later with a scheduled task

max_dim_threshold.label: SR Dimension Threshold
max_dim_threshold.description: Only upscale when the image's long side is below this value

max_bytes_threshold.label: SR File Size Threshold (bytes)
max_bytes_threshold.description: Only upscale when the image file is smaller than this

debug_capture.label: Debug Capture
debug_capture.description: When on, record raw responses for every task; otherwise only failed ones

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: Upstream service key; stored in the local config only

auth_mode.label: Auth Mode
auth_mode.description: Guest token needs no key: Amane fetches a short-lived token from the upstream and renews it

skip_keywords.label: Skip Keywords
skip_keywords.description: Texts containing any of these keywords are kept as-is without calling the model; use it for material the upstream content filter always rejects

translate_fields.label: Fields to Translate
translate_fields.description: Currently only title and plot are supported

api_type.label: API Type
api_type.description: Prefer Responses or Anthropic when the provider supports them

max_tokens.label: Max output tokens
max_tokens.description: Per-reply output cap. The provider rejects values above the model's limit

max_retries.label: Transport retries
max_retries.description: Retries after the first request; empty uses the SDK default (two). Set 0 to fail on the first rate limit

request_timeout.label: Turn timeout (seconds)
request_timeout.description: Maximum duration of one conversation turn; it stops and asks you to retry. Empty means no limit

rate_limit.label: Max requests per second
rate_limit.description: See the provider's docs; too high may trigger rate limiting

sql_timeout_ms.label: Query timeout (ms)
sql_timeout_ms.description: Default timeout for queries that run without approval; queries that exceed it need user approval

result_cache_ttl_s.label: Result cache duration (s)
result_cache_ttl_s.description: In-memory lifetime of delivered results; expired entries are re-run

history_ttl_s.label: Session history memory duration (s)
history_ttl_s.description: In-memory lifetime of session history; reloaded from disk on demand after eviction

history_max_sessions.label: Session History Capacity
history_max_sessions.description: Max sessions kept in the history hot cache (LRU)

keyword_enabled.label: Keyword search
keyword_enabled.description: Inverted index over number, title, plot, actors, tags, series, studio, publisher

vector_enabled.label: Vector search
vector_enabled.description: Semantic recall; first enable downloads the model and backfills the whole library

hybrid_enabled.label: Hybrid search
hybrid_enabled.description: Fuse both paths by relevance when both are on; otherwise concatenate each ordering

vector_engine.label: Vector engine
vector_engine.description: sqlite-vec uses the native extension; python scores in-process and gets slow on large libraries

embedding.label: Embedding model
embedding.description: Both implementations speak the same protocol; switching one for the other does not change how vectors are stored

provider.label: Embedding provider
provider.description: In-process ONNX inference, or any OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint

model.label: Model
model.description: FastEmbed model name when embedded; sent verbatim as model otherwise

dim.label: Vector dimension
dim.description: Must match the model; a mismatch fails loudly instead of degrading

threads.label: Inference threads
threads.description: Embedded provider only; empty uses the onnxruntime default

fusion.label: Fusion
fusion.description: How keyword hits and semantic similarity are combined into one order

zgate.label: Semantic gate
zgate.description: Cosine z-score below this counts as a miss; with fewer than ~300 rows it gates everything away

word_weight.label: Keyword bonus
word_weight.description: Flat bonus for keyword hits; exact number matches rank above it regardless

vector_k.label: Vector recall limit
vector_k.description: Paging deeper than this has no reliable ordering

db_name.label: Database Name
db_name.description: Database name used on import. Created by the importer

read_user.label: Read-only Role
read_user.description: Read-only account for queries. Created and granted by the importer

read_timeout.label: Query Timeout (s)
read_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for a single query

corners.label: Watermark position
corners.description: Multiple in the same corner stack in order: subtitle → uncensored → cracked → leaked → resolution

auto_scrape.label: Auto-scrape
auto_scrape.description: Automatically scrape actors when scraping movies

enabled.label: Enable plugin
enabled.description: Allow this plugin to participate in scrape routes

config.label: Plugin configuration
config.description: Configuration fields provided by the plugin
